_comment: Release notes shown to staff in the 'What's new' popup on first launch after an update. The CI 'Inject build metadata' step picks the TOP entry (latest) and injects its title + bullets into lib/build-info.ts. Add new entries to the TOP. Keep each entry's title under 50 chars and each bullet under 100 chars. Use empty strings or omit fields to skip them.

releases.title: Real leave balances per UAE + KSA labor law
highlights: My Leave now shows actual quotas per type instead of all-null — Annual + Sick + Maternity (for female staff) for 2026 populated for all 42 active staff
Annual quota follows UAE Art. 29 (30 days at 1+yr, pro-rata 6-12mo, 0 under 6mo) and KSA Art. 109 (21 days 1-5yr, 30 days 5+yr, pro-rata under 1yr)
Sick quotas: 90 days UAE / 120 days KSA
Seniority resolved from your oldest contract start date (tblhr_staff_contract.start_valid)
15 UAE + 2 KSA public holidays seeded for 2026 (was empty)
Backend: /api/my/leave/balance now reads the real source (tbltimesheets_day_off) instead of the broken type-table path — was returning all-null

releases.title: Real avatars + proper profile hero on Settings
highlights: Top-bar avatar, Dashboard welcome card, and Settings now show your actual photo (was a gray circle because we used the bare filename instead of the full Perfex URL)
Settings opens with a real profile hero: large avatar, name, role · department, and 'Joined Prizm Energy on …' from your start date
Removed the duplicate 'Account' name/email card below since the hero already shows everything
Backend hotfix: /api/my no longer 500s on 'Column date is ambiguous' — CheckinCard now loads real data instead of spinning forever

releases.title: Amber update ribbon + transparent logo + no more flicker
highlights: Update banner is back to amber/yellow — the original color you wanted, not blue
Prizm logo in the top bar now has a transparent background (no white tile)
Inbox strip no longer flashes stale items for a frame on cold launch — steady from the first paint
Backend: /api/inbox endpoint deployed so the Approvals / Tasks / Mentions / Compliance icons actually pull real data instead of always saying "All caught up"
Backend: /api/my/payslips and /api/my/leave/balance HTTP 500 collation errors fixed

releases.title: Real Prizm logo + welcome card on the Dashboard
highlights: The flash placeholder in the top-left is replaced with the actual Prizm brand mark
Dashboard now opens with a welcome card: your avatar, time-of-day greeting, and role / department
Mirrors the web admin landing strip so the two surfaces feel like one product
Tap the welcome card to jump to your profile / sign out screen

releases.title: New top bar — Prizm brand on the left, action icons on the right
highlights: Matches the Perfex web admin chrome — brand on the left, action icons on the right
Five icons replace the old chip strip: Approvals · Tasks · Mentions · Compliance · Your avatar
Red dot with the count appears on any icon that has pending items — at a glance
Tap the avatar at the far right to jump to Settings (sign out lives there)
Bottom-sheet drill-down with quick approve/reject actions is unchanged

releases.title: Update banner is back — with a real progress bar
highlights: When a new APK is published you now see the blue 'Update available' banner sliding down again
Tap Install — the banner morphs into a live progress bar (X% + a sliding fill)
When the download finishes Android's installer opens automatically
Tap × to dismiss this build; the banner won't reappear for the same SHA
Was regressed to a plain Alert popup in the last few builds — fixed

releases.title: Hotfix: session-expired now lands on Login (not red triangles)
highlights: Server rotated its signing key on 2026-05-23 — every old cached token started failing
Before this fix the app showed red-triangle alerts on every module instead of asking for a relogin
Now: any 'Signature verification failed' / 401 response clears your session and routes you to the login screen
Sign in once with your password — your new token works for every screen again
Coalesced so 6 background queries don't trigger 6 redirects in a row

releases.title: My Expenses — track what you've claimed
highlights: Settings → My Expenses: see every expense you've submitted
Summary card up top: total submitted, total billed to customers
Each row shows date, category, amount, with BILLED / BILLABLE badges
Tap to drill into the full expense detail (same screen as web)
Submission form with receipt-photo capture coming next batch

releases.title: My Payslips — view your pay history
highlights: Settings → My Payslips: every payslip you've ever received, newest first
Each card shows the month, payslip number, and headline net pay
Tap to drill into the full breakdown: gross, deductions, PAYE, net
Workdays + paid/unpaid leave days included on each payslip
PDF download coming in the next update

releases.title: Request leave from your phone
highlights: Settings → My Leave: see your balance per type and your request history
Tap + to submit: pick leave type, dates, optional reason
Status pills show pending / approved / rejected at a glance
Cancel a pending request right from the list
Goes through the same approval flow as the web (your approver gets notified)

releases.title: Check in / out from your phone
highlights: Big primary card at the top of Settings — tap to clock in, tap again to clock out
Shows your current shift status: 'Working since 9:02' with running hours/minutes
Honors the same IP whitelist + workplace rules the web check-in uses
Geo-fence by location coming next batch (needs expo-location)
Foundation for the broader Me tab — payslips, leave requests, more next

releases.title: Action Center: see what needs your attention from anywhere
highlights: New top bar on every screen showing 4 chips: Approvals · Tasks · Mentions · Compliance
Approvals: budget items, gatepasses, purchase requests, expense requests waiting on you
Tasks: assigned to you, sorted by Overdue · Today · This week · Later — with a 'Done' quick-action
Mentions: unread notifications, tap to jump straight to the source
Compliance: leave requests to approve, contracts / gatepasses expiring soon
My Activity feed in Settings — see every action you took, with a 'Mobile only' filter

releases.title: Projects, Proposals & Leads — full workflow on mobile
highlights: Projects: ⋮ menu now does Mark in Progress / On Hold / Finished / Cancelled — fires the same hooks the web does
Proposals: Send to client, Copy, Mark Open / Sent / Revised / Accepted / Declined
Leads: change status from the ⋮ menu (no more editing the raw status field) — fires after_lead_status_change so notifications + automations still run
Every action lands in the activity log tagged [Mobile] so admins see the source

releases.title: Workflow actions on 16 more modules + activity log tagging
highlights: Tickets: reply, change status / priority / assignee — all from the ⋮ menu
Estimates: send, convert to invoice, mark sent / accepted / declined
Invoices: send, record payment with full form, mark cancelled
Contracts: mark signed, send for signature, renew with new dates
Expenses: mark billable / not billable, copy
Tasks: start / stop timer, mark complete, reopen
Goals / Surveys / Knowledge articles: publish / unpublish / mark complete
Recruitment: hire / reject / change candidate stage
HR Payroll: mark payslip paid
Gatepass: approve / reject / close — security workflow from the phone
Fixed Equipment: allocate to staff / return
Budget items: approve / reject classification
Every action lands in the activity log tagged [Mobile] so admins see the source

releases.title: Tenders, Opportunities, Purchase, RFQs — full workflow on mobile
highlights: Tap the ⋮ menu on any record to run workflow actions — no more 'view-only' on mobile
Tenders: mark Won / Lost / change status straight from the phone
Opportunities: change stage, change status, submit for approval
Purchase Orders: approve, reject, send to supplier, mark received, mark paid
Purchase Requests: publish or close
Every action shows up in the activity log (tagged [Mobile]) so admins see who did what from where

releases.title: Custom fields, date pickers, file uploads
highlights: Custom Fields section now appears on every record (whatever your admin defined in Settings)
Date and datetime fields use a native calendar picker — no more typing YYYY-MM-DD
Files tab on customers / projects / tasks / leads / invoices — upload from camera, gallery, or any document
Lead status/source and ticket priority/status show as readable labels instead of raw IDs
Searchable picker when editing relations (country, currency, staff, customer, source, status)
